menu.followParagraph: Follow the Section at the Playhead

clip.title: Clip
clip.hidden: Not shown: what it was attached to no longer exists
clip.slotBackHint: Opaque scenes such as Tempera's large color blocks or a cover background will cover it.
clip.slotMidHint: Drawn over the scene's graphics and under the lyrics (Tempera's lyric inversion reads it); at shot changes and section transitions it moves above the scene for that moment, so it never flickers.
clip.position: Position (you can also drag it on the preview)
clip.followAmountHint: 1 moves together with the lyrics; less feels like a background further away.

motionHints.none: A path animation that keeps moving while shown (eased Bézier curves). Useful in scenes where the camera barely moves, such as Lumiere.
motionHints.float: Goes up and down along an arc, pausing naturally at each end.
motionHints.drift: Slides toward the center along a gentle S-curve over the whole clip, easing in and out.
motionHints.push: Slowly grows and rises slightly, like the camera pushing in.
motionHints.sway: Swings back and forth with a little rotation.

effectHints.echo: Silhouettes of the image expand outward and fade, ring after ring, in a loop (a common effect in character-art lyric videos).
effectHints.glow: A soft glow around the image's outline.
effectHints.shadow: A solid silhouette offset to the lower right, like a sticker's shadow.

followHints.off: Fixed on the frame; does not move with the camera.
followHints.scene: Moves with the camera like anything in the scene (push, pan, rotate) and jumps at shot changes. Position and size are the values without camera motion.
followHints.motion: Follows only the push, drift and breathing within a shot; every shot starts from the original position, so it never jumps.

background.deleted: This background clip has been deleted.
background.title: Background clip
background.hidden: Not shown: its attachment or media no longer exists
background.stacking: Clips sit on top of the default background, which shows through the gaps between them; later clips cover earlier ones.
background.videoNote: The video's sound is not included in the export. Frames are decoded one by one on export, so picture and time match exactly.

backgroundTrack.title: Background track
backgroundTrack.empty: No background clips yet: the whole song uses the default background above. You can switch to a gradient, image or video per section.
backgroundTrack.hint: Add images and videos to the media library first, or right-click a card there and choose "Set as background".

autoArrange.probabilityHint: The chance that a shot gets an image; re-arranging the same arrangement gives the same result, and lowering it only removes some.
autoArrange.varietyHint: 0 = fixed position; higher switches more often between compositions with different distance, offset and tilt. Drawn per shot, so re-arranging gives the same result.
autoArrange.motionHint: Eased path animation, so images never sit completely still in scenes where the camera barely moves (such as Lumiere).
autoArrange.clear_one: Remove the {{count}} auto-arranged clip (ones you placed yourself stay)
autoArrange.clear_other: Remove the {{count}} auto-arranged clips (ones you placed yourself stay)
autoArrange.explain: Images take turns shot by shot and change when the shot changes: character art mostly alternates left and right, sliding in from its side; wide images tend to go in the middle; compositions vary in distance, offset and tilt according to the variety setting.
autoArrange.existing_one: There is {{count}} auto-arranged clip; re-arranging replaces only auto-arranged clips, never the ones you placed.
autoArrange.existing_other: There are {{count}} auto-arranged clips; re-arranging replaces only those, never the ones you placed.
autoArrange.afterwards: Every clip can be adjusted on its own afterwards.
autoArrange.noImages: Auto-arrange: the media library has no images yet
autoArrange.noShots: Auto-arrange: no suitable shots (add lyrics first)

library.placedFollowing: Placed "{{name}}" on the frame (following the current shot)
library.importedMany_one: Added {{count}} file to the media library
library.importedMany_other: Added {{count}} files to the media library
library.importedSomeFailed_one: Added {{count}} file to the media library ({{failed}} failed)
library.importedSomeFailed_other: Added {{count}} files to the media library ({{failed}} failed)
library.temperaAutoHint: Let {{pack}} pick this image automatically per shot
library.setBackgroundParagraph: Set as Background: Section at Playhead
library.setBackgroundHint: Use as the background of the section at the playhead
library.deleteWithClips: Delete from Media Library (with Its Clips)
library.drop: Drop to add to the media library
library.hint: Images can be placed on the frame in three layers — below the scene, above the scene, or topmost — and can follow shots, sections or lyric lines. Transparent PNGs work best. Videos can only be backgrounds (right-click → "Set as background").
